title: ALFWorld passed data admission; model learnability is the next gate
decision: Admit the disjoint 16-episode ALFWorld fixture for a bounded random-oracle and tiny-set overfit gate; do not admit a full model sweep yet.
plain_summary: All four model pathways pass their process gates, and 16 official ALFWorld episodes pass split-disjointness, exact replay, goal-success, and non-oracle catalogue checks. Full collection and model selection remain blocked on tiny-set learnability.
